title: MorphosyntaxBatchItem
description: Batch item for morphosyntax NLP processing.

runs.description:
Run lengths partitioning `words`: a tokenizer may merge words only
within one run, since something (a retrace, a pause, a bracket)
stands between runs on the main tier.

special_forms.description: Special form and language per word: (form_type, resolved_language).

terminator.description:
Utterance terminator. Typed; serializes to its CHAT surface form
(`.`, `?`, `!`, etc.) over the IPC boundary so the Stanza worker
continues to receive a plain string.

words.description:
Provider request words: actual source text or the protocol's special-form
mask. A mask never claims to be a provenance-sealed transcript word.
